label: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017
output:
Moved Phibsborough to Drumcondra on Sat 17 Oct with Kilbarrack Van Co. Two-bed flat but mostly my own stuff, and the new place is a 4th floor walkup with no lift, which I probably should have said louder when booking.

Quote was €340 for up to 4 hours, two lads and the van. Took about three and a half in the end. Booked through the website, €50 deposit by Revolut, no messing about with any of that.

The honest bit first: they were meant to be there at 9 and landed at half 10. I got a text at 8:40 saying the previous job had overrun, which I did appreciate, better than sitting there guessing, but I was perched on a pile of boxes with a cold coffee for an hour and a half. If you're on a tight handover with a landlord that's the difference between grand and a pain in the hoop, so either build a bit of slack into your morning or ask them straight out what slot they're actually working to.

Once they were in the door it was grand. The couch wasn't going round the turn on the 3rd floor and I'd already written it off, and one of the young lads (Kev, I think) had the legs off it with an allen key out of his pocket before I'd finished the sentence. Straight in after that, no drama.

Only real complaint is the base of my brass floor lamp got chipped. Everything else was wrapped in blankets, proper job, but the lamp went in bare and took a knock. It was my nanny's so I was a bit gutted, and I'd have wrapped it myself if I'd copped it in time. Wrap the lamps, lads. That's the one thing I'd change.

Fair play on the rest of it though. They put the bed back together without being asked, and took away a flat pack shelf I didn't want rather than leaving me stuck with it in the hall. Dessie knocked €40 off the bill afterwards because of the lateness and I never asked him for it, which says a fair bit about how he runs it.

I'd use them again. They were the best value I found by a mile, the other quotes I got were all €450 plus, so €300 for the job was decent.

Four stars and not five, because of the wait and the lamp, but it's a solid four. If your move is straightforward and you're not up against a deadline, you'll be well looked after.
